page.overview:
Who is Paulecrain de Fanouilley?

Ser Paulecrain de Fanouilley is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV: Heavensward. He is a member of the Heavens' Ward.

Paulecrain rose from poverty by his skill with the lance alone. Although he was taken into the service of House Fortemps for his talented spearwork, he was dismissed after assaulting a noble of the House.

Some time later, he crossed paths with Ser Grinnaux at the Forgotten Knight, and traded barbs over drinks until their heated conversation escalated into a brawl. An unusual kinship arose between them and the dishonored Paulecrain was taken in by House Dzemael, who found him an invaluable addition for his willingness to carry out questionable tasks others would not. For his loyalty, he was granted a knighthood, and he remained close friends with Ser Grinnaux.

Ser Paulecrain and Ser Grinnaux de Dzemael arrested Alphinaud Leveilleur and Tataru Taru, accusing them of heresy. As the Warrior of Light could not call upon the Lord Commander in saving those accused by the Heavens' Ward, they challenged both Ser Grinnaux and Ser Paulecrain to a trial by combat to rescue their fellow Scions.
